about.title: About
about.hero.title: The Laravel community of Bangladesh since 2012
about.hero.lead: Laravel Bangladesh is the official community of Laravel developers, engineers, artisans and enthusiasts in Bangladesh. What began in 2012 as a small group of developers has grown to more than 21,000 members who learn, build and hire together.
about.manifesto.title: What we do
about.manifesto.1.title: Meetups and workshops
about.manifesto.1.body: Regular in-person meetups in Dhaka and other cities, along with hands-on workshops. Talks are given by community members, from first-time speakers to senior engineers.
about.manifesto.2.title: Knowledge sharing
about.manifesto.2.body: Talks are recorded and shared with the community together with slides and notes. Discussion happens in English and Bangla, whichever is more comfortable.
about.manifesto.3.title: Careers and connections
about.manifesto.3.body: Members find collaborators, mentors, clients and jobs through the community. Companies use it to find Laravel talent in Bangladesh.
about.night.title: What to expect at a meetup
about.night.1.title: Registration and networking
about.night.1.body: Check in, meet other members and settle in before the talks begin.
about.night.2.title: Talks and sessions
about.night.2.body: Around five talks or sessions on Laravel, PHP and related tools, each followed by questions from the audience.
about.night.3.title: Open discussion
about.night.3.body: Time to continue conversations, ask for help with a problem and connect with speakers and other attendees.
about.who.title: Who is part of the community
about.who.1: Developers and engineers who build with Laravel and PHP in Bangladesh, or who are learning to.
about.who.2: Students and career changers starting out in web development.
about.who.3: Companies, agencies and freelancers who work with Laravel and want to hire or collaborate locally.
about.join.title: How to take part
about.join.1.title: Create an account
about.join.1.body: Log in with your email. We send a code or magic link, so there is no password to remember. A new email address creates your account, and you can add a passkey afterwards for faster login.
about.join.2.title: Register for an event
about.join.2.body: Browse upcoming meetups and workshops and register in one step.
about.join.3.title: Get involved
about.join.3.body: Propose a talk, add yourself to the directory or volunteer to help organise. The community is run by its members.
about.cities.title: Across Bangladesh
about.cities.body: The community began in Dhaka, where most meetups are held. Members now join from cities across Bangladesh and from abroad, in person when they can and online when they cannot.
about.cities.list: Dhaka · Chattogram · Sylhet · Khulna · Rajshahi · Rangpur

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.lead: The rules for using laravelbd.com. By using the site you agree to them.
terms.1.title: About these terms
terms.1.body: laravelbd.com is run by Laravel Bangladesh, a volunteer-run community of Laravel developers. It is not a company. These terms apply to everyone who visits the site or creates an account. If you do not agree with them, please do not use the site.
terms.2.title: Your account
terms.2.body:
You must be at least 13 years old to create an account.

Use your real name and an email address you control. Login works through codes, magic links and passkeys sent to or stored on your devices, so keep your email account and devices secure. You are responsible for what happens under your account.
terms.3.title: Community conduct
terms.3.body:
Be respectful to other members, online and at events. You must not:

- harass, threaten or discriminate against anyone
- post hateful, sexually explicit or illegal content
- impersonate other people or organisations
- send spam or unsolicited advertising
- try to break, overload or gain unauthorised access to the site
terms.4.title: Content you submit
terms.4.body:
You keep ownership of what you submit, such as your directory profile, talk proposals and event registration answers.

By submitting it, you allow Laravel Bangladesh to store, display and share it as needed to run the site and its events. For example, we publish your directory profile once it is approved, and list your talk in an event schedule if it is accepted. Only submit content you have the right to share.
terms.5.title: Events
terms.5.body:
Events are organised by volunteers. Dates, venues and speakers can change, and events can be cancelled. Seats may be limited, so registering can put you on a waitlist.

At in-person events, follow the venue rules and the organisers' instructions. Events may be photographed or recorded, and those photos and recordings may be published on this site. Tell an organiser if you prefer not to appear.
terms.6.title: Moderation
terms.6.body: We may edit, unpublish or remove content, and suspend or delete accounts, that break these terms or harm the community.
terms.7.title: Links to other sites
terms.7.body: Resources, directory profiles and events link to websites and videos run by others. We are not responsible for their content or how they handle your data.
terms.8.title: Trademarks
terms.8.body: Laravel and the Laravel logo are trademarks of Laravel Holdings Inc. Laravel Bangladesh is an independent community and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Laravel Holdings Inc.
terms.9.title: No warranty
terms.9.body: The site is provided as it is by volunteers. We do our best to keep it available and accurate, but we cannot guarantee that it will always work or that everything on it is correct.
terms.10.title: Limitation of liability
terms.10.body: As far as the law allows, Laravel Bangladesh and its volunteers are not liable for any loss or damage arising from your use of the site or from attending its events.
terms.11.title: Leaving
terms.11.body: You can stop using the site at any time. To have your account and its data deleted, email us as described in the Privacy Policy.
terms.12.title: Changes to these terms
terms.12.body: We may update these terms. When we do, we change the date at the top of this page. If you keep using the site after a change, you accept the updated terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: What personal information laravelbd.com collects, why we need it, who we share it with, and how you can have it corrected or deleted.
privacy.1.title: Who we are
privacy.1.body: laravelbd.com is run by Laravel Bangladesh, a volunteer-run community of Laravel developers. It is not a company. For any question or request about your data, email management@laravelbd.com.
privacy.2.title: What we collect
privacy.2.body:
- Account: your name, email address and preferred language. We never ask for a password.
- Login: when you ask for a login code or magic link, we store your email address, name, IP address and a one-way hash of the code. If you add a passkey, we store its public key and when it was last used. The private key never leaves your device.
- Events: your registrations and your answers to an event's registration questions.
- Talk proposals: the titles, abstracts and notes you submit to a call for papers.
- Directory profile: if you create one, the name, title, company, city, bio, photo and links you add.
- Technical data: your IP address, browser details and the pages you request, recorded in your session and in our server logs.
privacy.3.title: How we use it
privacy.3.body:
- to log you in and keep you logged in
- to organise the events you register for
- to review the talk proposals you submit
- to publish your directory profile
- to protect the site from abuse, for example by limiting repeated login attempts
- to understand how many people visit and which pages they use

We do not sell your information or use it for advertising.
privacy.4.title: What is public
privacy.4.body: Your directory profile, once published, and speaker details for talks you give are visible to everyone and may appear in search engines. Your email address, registrations, registration answers and talk proposals are visible only to you and to the community staff who run the site.
privacy.5.title: Cookies
privacy.5.body: We only use cookies the site needs to work: a session cookie that keeps you logged in, and a security token that protects forms against forged requests. Cloudflare may set cookies of its own to protect the site from bots. We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.
privacy.6.title: Services we rely on
privacy.6.body:
- Cloudflare: all traffic to the site passes through Cloudflare's network, which protects and speeds it up. Cloudflare also gives us visitor statistics without using cookies, and stores the images you upload.
- Email delivery: an email provider sends login codes, magic links and account emails on our behalf.
- YouTube: some videos on the site are embedded from YouTube. When a page with an embedded video loads, YouTube, which is owned by Google, may collect information about you under its own privacy policy.

These providers may process your information outside Bangladesh.
privacy.7.title: How long we keep it
privacy.7.body: Login codes and magic links expire after 15 minutes. Your session ends after 2 hours of inactivity. Server logs are kept only as long as we need them to run and secure the site. Your account information is kept until you ask us to delete your account.
privacy.8.title: Your choices
privacy.8.body:
- Change your name, email address and language, and manage your passkeys, in your account settings.
- Edit your directory profile from your account.
- Email management@laravelbd.com to get a copy of your information, have it corrected, or have your account and its data deleted.
privacy.9.title: Security
privacy.9.body: The site is only served over HTTPS, login never uses passwords, login codes are stored only as hashes, and access to personal information is limited to community staff. No system is perfectly secure, so if you notice a problem, please tell us.
privacy.10.title: Children
privacy.10.body: The site is not meant for children under 13. If we learn that a child under 13 has created an account, we will delete it.
privacy.11.title: Changes to this policy
privacy.11.body: We may update this policy. When we do, we change the date at the top of this page.
privacy.12.title: Contact
privacy.12.body: Questions or requests about your data: management@laravelbd.com
